svg.title: DFIR Hawk v1.0 — Enterprise Architecture
svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI-ASSISTED INCIDENT RESPONSE · v1.0 · 69 CONTROLS · MITRE ATT&CK v15 · STIX 2.1 · RFC 3227 · FIPS 140-2
01 Evidence Collection — RFC 3227 Volatile Order · RFC 3161 Trusted Timestamp · Collector Integrity Verified
RFC 3227 ORDER → ① RAM ② Processes ③ Network State ④ Disk · Collector SHA-256 verified before execution · RFC 3161 timestamp at acquisition
02 Secure Staging — AES-256 at Rest · Access Logged · Classification Enforced · Retention Policy · Integrity Re-verification Schedule
Structured Case Directory — Isolated per Case-ID · AES-256 Encrypted at Rest
SHA-256 Manifest · Re-hashed on write · Periodic sweep
FS Access Log · Retention Policy · Recovery Snapshot
03 MCP Forensic Tool Server — RBAC · HMAC Signed · seccomp Sandboxed · Tool Versioned · Rate Limited · Zero-Egress Network
dfir-hawk-mcp-server · Each tool: isolated subprocess · seccomp / gVisor sandbox · Tool version pinned per case · HMAC per message
Input sanitisation · Path-traversal guard · File-size cap + chunked ingestion · Short-lived case-scoped tokens · Token revocation · Inter-tool data isolation · Zero outbound network
03.5 Vector Store + Anomaly Detection — RAG Context · Embedding Freshness · Clock Skew Detection
ChromaDB / Qdrant · Evidence embedded on ingest · Relevant chunks retrieved per query · Re-indexed on case change
Statistical outlier detection · Rare process trees · Clock skew flagged · Embedding staleness alert
04 Data Protection + AI Inference — Hard-Fail DLP · Prompt Injection Guard · Structured Output · Confidence Scoring · Legal Safety Filter
DLP Filter · Hard Fail · PII / Hostname / IP Scrub · Aborts on Exception · Prompt Injection Guard applied post-scrub · Jurisdiction policy check
Air-Gap Safe · FIPS 140-2 · No data leaves network
Model weights SHA-256 verified · Version pinned per case · Drift detection
CPU affinity + timing normalisation · Fine-tuning pipeline via feedback
Default for all IR work · Multi-model consensus on high-severity findings
Post-DLP only · Explicit analyst opt-in · Short-lived session token
Token budget + chunking enforced · Logged to audit trail
Adversarial prompt red-teaming · Active learning: uncertain findings surfaced first

AI Output Pipeline · Pydantic schema enforcement · Confidence score (0–1) per finding · Hallucination check: every IOC cross-referenced · Legal safety filter: no attribution without evidence threshold · Unvalidated findings flagged
05 Forensic Analysis — Deconfliction · IOC Enrichment · ATT&CK Scoring · Hypothesis Engine · Deception Detection · Playbook Engine
Ransomware · BEC · Cloud Breach playbooks · Auto-triggers on detection
06 Reporting — STIX 2.1 · Report Versioning · Redaction · Regulatory Outputs · Explainability · Witness Integration · Case State
Analyst Review Gate — Human Sign-Off Required · Confidence scores visible · Corrections: {tool · finding_id · correction · analyst_id · timestamp}
Analyst Feedback Loop · Corrections → YARA / Sigma / Fine-tuning · Closed-loop confirmation required before case close · Case state: created → collecting → analysing → review → closed → archived
07 Deployment — Health Monitoring · Resource Limits · Secure Updates · Distributed Operation · Disaster Recovery
Health endpoint · cgroup limits · Signed offline updates
Multi-node · Job queue · Parallel analysis across nodes
Case state snapshots · Evidence backup · DR recovery runbook
RFC 3227 · RFC 3161 · AES-256 · FIPS 140-2 · STIX 2.1 · MITRE ATT&CK v15 · WORM audit · seccomp · HMAC · RAG · Vault · Pydantic · Fine-tuning · Playbooks · Regulatory outputs
